articles.title: Coinbase lets users transfer stock portfolios as exchange expands beyond crypto
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange is deepening its push into traditional finance by enabling ACATS stock transfers and expanding trading products beyond digital assets.

articles.title: Why US-regulated Bitcoin perpetuals could change crypto trading
articles.snippet: US-regulated Bitcoin perpetual futures could give retail and institutional traders new ways to access crypto derivatives.

articles.title: Bitcoin stocks divergence returns as BTC dips to $66K while oil drops under $78
articles.snippet: Bitcoin joined oil in heading lower while stocks gained on US-Iran peace momentum, with traders seeing a quick end to the BTC price rebound.

articles.title: Robinhood cuts 10% of workforce as Tenev touts business strength
articles.snippet: Robinhood cuts about 10% of staff as CEO Vlad Tenev says business “has never been stronger” despite weak Q1 trading.

articles.title: Kraken rolls out perpetual futures for US traders through CFTC-regulated venue
articles.snippet: The offering follows Kraken's acquisition of Bitnomial and comes amid a broader push to bring crypto derivatives trading onshore.
